prompt.name: Agent monochrome
prompt.prompt: Create ONE finished 2D/2.5D fighting-game character sprite, ONE full body only, isolated on a truly transparent background. Single static neutral-ready pose facing screen RIGHT, three-quarter side view, head and feet both visible, feet on one common ground baseline. Portrait composition, complete silhouette with at least 5 percent transparent margin all round. Match the refined hand-painted game-sprite style and identity of the first standing figure in the reference, not the whole atlas. Clean solid outlines, precise material shading, readable anatomy and equipment attachments. Do not make a sprite sheet, pose variations, multiple characters, comparison layout, text, captions, UI, backdrop, floor, cast shadow, glow or atmospheric haze. The requested clothes are an original CQC costume, not an official released-game outfit. Preserve the same period-specific character and do not borrow another incarnation. SOLID SNAKE from Ghost Babel, original retro monochrome costume study “Agent monochrome”. Draw a NEW complete sprite by hand in crisp old-school pixel-art language, not a resized, blurred, dithered or recolored copy of one atlas frame. Preserve the reference period-specific Solid Snake identity: brown/silhouetted short swept hair, tied headband with two trailing tails, compact tactical sneaking suit, padded torso, gloves, belt pouches, fitted trousers and sturdy boots. Use a deliberately limited FOUR-shade olive-green monochrome appearance inspired by Game Boy Color-era sprites, dark green outline through pale olive highlight. A clean square-pixel grid, hard pixel clusters, no gradient airbrush, no soft edges, no modern painted texture. One original right-facing full-body neutral alert stance with natural limb anatomy and no weapon aiming. Transparent background, ONE figure, generous empty transparent border. This is a newly drawn CQC retro interpretation; no UI or MSX labels.

visualReview.description: Newly drawn retro monochrome interpretation, no CPU pixel reduction or recolor.
visualReview.note: Physically viewed: independently generated new right-facing monochrome olive pixel-art body, complete silhouette and distinct pose; no CPU pixel reduction/recolor applied. Raw output is an artistic retro interpretation, not a verified hardware-exact four-color palette.
visualReview.limits: Original CQC design; no claim of official outfit or exact recovered historical pixels. Anchor is preliminary and may be refined in catalogue QA.
